description: SCADA alarm types categorized by business domain

items.label: Communication Alarm
items.description: Network interruption, protocol error, communication timeout

items.label: Overlimit Alarm
items.description: Value exceeds upper/lower limit thresholds (high-high, high, low, low-low) — generated by pipeline limit check

items.label: Data Alarm
items.description: Data quality abnormality, data loss, deviation out of range, rate of change out of range

items.label: Safety Alarm
items.description: Safety threshold exceeded, emergency stop, interlock triggered

items.label: Power Alarm
items.description: Power supply abnormality, voltage/current/frequency out of range

items.label: Process Alarm
items.description: Process parameter deviation, workflow abnormality, batch error

items.label: Environment Alarm
items.description: Temperature/humidity abnormality, gas concentration, environmental monitoring

items.label: System Alarm
items.description: Insufficient system resources, service status abnormality, configuration error

items.label: Security Alarm
items.description: Intrusion, access control abnormality, video surveillance anomaly
